  IF(
    Brand__c = "Atlantic Systems", 
    "a5wUP000006qwpGYAQ",

    IF(
      Brand__c = "Atlantic Systems", 
      "a5wUP000006qwpGYAQ",

    ),
    IF(
      AND(
        ISPICKVAL(Reason, "Pinpad Return (Processing Attrition)"),

      ),
      IF(
        Brand__c = "Atlantic Systems", 
        "a5wUP000006qwpGYAQ",

      ),
      IF(
        AND(
          ISPICKVAL(Reason, "External RMA"), 
          ISPICKVAL(Order_Type__c, "Return")
        ),
        IF(
          Brand__c = "Atlantic Systems", 
          "a5wUP000006qwpGYAQ",
          "a5wUP000003DGA6YAO"
        ),
        IF(
          AND(
            ISPICKVAL(Reason, "Rental Return"), 
            ISPICKVAL(Order_Type__c, "Return")
          ),
          IF(
            Brand__c = "Atlantic Systems", 
            "a5wUP000006qwyGYAQ",

          ),
          IF(
            AND(
              ISPICKVAL(Reason, "Order Fulfillment"),
              ISPICKVAL(Order_Type__c, "Fulfillment")

            IF(
              Brand__c = "Atlantic Systems",

fields.name: Last_Activity__c
fields.label: Last Activity
fields.formula:
IF(
    AND(
        ISBLANK(Last_Call_Date__c),
        ISBLANK(Last_Email_Date__c),
        ISBLANK(Last_Event_Date__c),
        ISBLANK(Last_SMS_Date__c),
        ISBLANK(Last_Note_Date__c)
    ),
    NULL,
    IF(
        AND(
            OR(ISBLANK(Last_Email_Date__c), Last_Call_Date__c >= Last_Email_Date__c),
            OR(ISBLANK(Last_Event_Date__c), Last_Call_Date__c >= Last_Event_Date__c),
            OR(ISBLANK(Last_SMS_Date__c), Last_Call_Date__c >= Last_SMS_Date__c),
            OR(ISBLANK(Last_Note_Date__c), Last_Call_Date__c >= Last_Note_Date__c)
        ),
        Last_Call_Date__c,
        IF(
            AND(
                OR(ISBLANK(Last_Call_Date__c), Last_Email_Date__c >= Last_Call_Date__c),
                OR(ISBLANK(Last_Event_Date__c), Last_Email_Date__c >= Last_Event_Date__c),
                OR(ISBLANK(Last_SMS_Date__c), Last_Email_Date__c >= Last_SMS_Date__c),
                OR(ISBLANK(Last_Note_Date__c), Last_Email_Date__c >= Last_Note_Date__c)
            ),
            Last_Email_Date__c,
            IF(
                AND(
                    OR(ISBLANK(Last_Call_Date__c), Last_Event_Date__c >= Last_Call_Date__c),
                    OR(ISBLANK(Last_Email_Date__c), Last_Event_Date__c >= Last_Email_Date__c),
                    OR(ISBLANK(Last_SMS_Date__c), Last_Event_Date__c >= Last_SMS_Date__c),
                    OR(ISBLANK(Last_Note_Date__c), Last_Event_Date__c >= Last_Note_Date__c)
                ),
                Last_Event_Date__c,
                IF(
                    AND(
                        OR(ISBLANK(Last_Call_Date__c), Last_SMS_Date__c >= Last_Call_Date__c),
                        OR(ISBLANK(Last_Email_Date__c), Last_SMS_Date__c >= Last_Email_Date__c),
                        OR(ISBLANK(Last_Event_Date__c), Last_SMS_Date__c >= Last_Event_Date__c),
                        OR(ISBLANK(Last_Note_Date__c), Last_SMS_Date__c >= Last_Note_Date__c)
                    ),
                    Last_SMS_Date__c,
                    Last_Note_Date__c
                )
            )
        )
    )
)

This field may be populated manually, as well as automatically when an order is created by using the Payment Console or Payment Request from Chargent Anywhere, given the proper configuration is in place. If a Payment Method is associated with the Chargent Order, this field will be updated with the Account value from the Payment Method record.
fields.help: Use this field to associate this order with the Account that owns this payment source and payment profile, aka Chargent Order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Bank_Account_Name__c
fields.label: Bank Account Name
fields.desc: The name on the bank account, typically a first and last name, or company name for business accounts.
fields.help: The name of the owner on the Bank Account. e.g., Benjamin Franklin, Chargent Inc.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Bank_Account_Number__c
fields.label: Bank Account Number
fields.desc: The unique identification number for the specific account at the financial institution that the payer is using to facilitate payments.
fields.help: Please enter the Bank Account number without spaces or dashes.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Bank_Name__c
fields.label: Bank Name
fields.desc:
Commercial name of the financial institution that the bank account is at.
e.g., NAB, RBS, Wells Fargo, Bank of America
fields.help: E.g., Wells Fargo Bank, WestPac, RBS, Bank of America or the Royal Bank of Canada

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Bank_Routing_Number__c
fields.label: Bank Routing Number
fields.desc:
This is the string of numbers that identifies a financial institution.

This value is called by different names on different systems and in different countries.  E.g., SWIFT, IBAN, BIC, Bank Code, BSB, Routing Number
fields.help:
Please enter the bank ID number with no spaces or dashes.

Goes by many names: SWIFT, IBAN, BIC, Bank Code, BSB or Routing Number

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_Address_Line_2__c
fields.label: Billing Address Line 2
fields.desc:
The apt, suite, floor, unit of the address associated with the payment source being used for this order. 

e.g., Apt 3, Unit 15, Floor 2
fields.help: E.g., Apt. #, Unit, Floor

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_Address__c
fields.label: Billing Address
fields.desc:
The street name and address number associated with the payment source being used for this order. 

e.g., 1234 Main St.
fields.help:
Street address

e.g., 870 Market St

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_City__c
fields.label: Billing City
fields.desc: The city of the address associated with the payment source being used for this order.
fields.help: E.g., Madrid, Sydney, London, Toronto, Seattle

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_Company__c
fields.label: Billing Company
fields.desc: The name of the organization associated with the payment source being used for this order.
fields.help: E.g., AppFrontier LLC, Google, Salesforce, UnitedWay, Tuff Shed

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_Country__c
fields.label: Billing Country
fields.desc: The country of the address associated with the payment source for this order.
fields.help: E.g,, Australia, Canada, USA, UK, Singapore
pick: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_Email__c
fields.label: Billing Email
fields.desc:
The email address where billing notifications related to this order will be sent. This email address will receive automated emails from the Chargent system including but not limited to: payment receipts, Payment Request emails, and Automated Collections emails.  

This information IS NOT shared with AppFrontier LLC, the makers of Chargent.
fields.help: E.g., AR@mycompany.com, ceo@appfrontier.com

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_Fax__c
fields.label: Billing Fax
fields.desc: The payer's fax number.  It is sent to some gateways.
fields.help: Phone number of the fax machine at the payer's location.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_First_Name__c
fields.label: Billing First Name
fields.desc: The first name associated with the payment source being used for this order.
fields.help: E.g., Deborah, Karen, Kimberly, Selena, Chad, Timothy

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_Last_Name__c
fields.label: Billing Last Name
fields.desc: The last name associated with the payment source being used for this order.
fields.help: E.g., Ng, Smith, Craig, Hecht

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_Phone__c
fields.label: Billing Phone
fields.desc: The phone number associated with the payment source being used for this order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_State_Province__c
fields.label: Billing State/Province
fields.desc: If populated, this field is used instead of the Billing State picklist.
fields.help:
Use this field when the Billing State picklist does not have the value you need.

E.g., Gyeonggi, Bavaria

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_State__c
fields.label: Billing State
fields.desc: The state of the address associated with the payment source being used for this order.
fields.help: Pick the correct option from the list.  If the correct option is not available use the Billing State/Province (text) field to input the correct answer.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Billing_Zip_Postal__c
fields.label: Billing Zip/Postal
fields.desc: The zip / postal code associated with the payment source being used for this order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__CPF_Number__c
fields.label: CPF Number
fields.desc: The CPF number, used for payments on the AstroPay gateway.  In the LATAM market.  As of Chargent 6.0 it is not used in other gateways.
fields.help: Used in some cash payment transactions.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Card_Expiration_Month__c
fields.label: Card Expiration Month
fields.desc: The month of the expiration date for the card being used for payment on this order.
fields.help: Enter the expiry month in this field.  Using a 2 number format.  e.g., 01, 12

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Card_Expiration_Year__c
fields.label: Card Expiration Year
fields.desc: The year of the expiration date for the card being used for payment on this order.
fields.help: Enter the expiry year in this field.  Using a 2 number format.  e.g., 24, 29

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Card_Last_4__c
fields.label: Card Last 4
fields.desc: The last four digits of the card being used for payment on this order.
fields.help: This field shows the final 4 digits of the card.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Card_Month_Indicator__c
fields.label: Card Expiration Month Indicator
fields.desc: This field receives the value of ChargentOrders__Card_Expiration_Month__c upon record creation. It is used the TChargentBatchProcessing batch process as well as the "OrderChargent" trigger.
fields.help: This field shows the expiry month of the card.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Card_Number__c
fields.label: Card Number
fields.desc: The full card number of the card being used for payment on this order.
fields.help: Please enter the full card number without spaces or dashes.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Card_Year_Indicator__c
fields.label: Card Expiration Year Indicator
fields.desc: This field receives the value of ChargentOrders__Card_Expiration_Year__c upon record creation. It is used in the TChargentBatchProcessing batch process as well as the "OrderChargent" trigger.
fields.help: This field shows the expiry year of the card.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Charge_Amount__c
fields.label: Charge Amount
fields.desc: The amount to be authorized or charged by the next transaction. If there are multiple charges, this field will automatically reflect the Amount of the order minus the total amount of successful charges.
fields.help: This is the amount that will be sent to the gateway to be charged or authorized to the card or taken from the bank account.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Charge_Date__c
fields.label: Charge Date
fields.desc:
This field displays the day of the month on which this recurring order collects payment.

The Chargent batch looks at the last transaction that is marked as recurring then charges again based on the frequency.  This caused slippage when there is a late payment.   

E.g., If a customer late pays by 11 days 3 months in a row, without Charge Date set you would miss a month's payment.   With Charge date set, the payment source will be charged the following month on the day of month set in this field.
fields.help: The Charge Date indicates which day of the month our recurring batch will charge for this order. In instances where a late payment is received, this field ensures that the subsequent payments will occur on the originally scheduled day of the month.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Check_Number__c
fields.label: Check Number
fields.desc: Used when recording paper checks in Chargent.  This is sent to some gateways, when using the ACH system in the USA.
fields.help: Only enter the check number here if you are using the ACH system to cash a paper check digitally or you are doing a manual transaction to log checks that you have received.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Credit_Amount__c
fields.label: Credit Amount
fields.desc: The amount to be credited when sending unlinked / unreferenced credits.
fields.help: When sending money from your organization to another person or business, simply enter the amount you wish to send here.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Currency__c
fields.label: Currency (Old)
fields.desc: Thie field is used by a couple of the Chargent batches. It determines the currency for the Charge Amount. The inline VF currency component sets that field's value. The label for this field includes "(old)" as it is no longer on the Chargent Order page layout by default as it is prefered that the VF currency component is used instead.
fields.help: Only supported with Barclays ePDQ gateway

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Customer_IP__c
fields.label: Customer IP
fields.desc: This field displays the IP address of the customer during the transaction and is commonly used for fraud prevention.
fields.help: Use this field for cases wherein you must send the customer IP address do the gateway.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Customer_Token__c
fields.label: Customer Token
fields.desc: This field records the Recurring Profile ID for PayFlow Pro and Braintree gateway customers.
fields.help: This token represents the customer at the gateway, rather than the payment source.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Date_of_Birth__c
fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.desc:
Birth date of the customer associated with this order. 

As of Chargent 6.0, this field is used by AstroPay gateway only.
fields.help: The birthday of the person who this record is related to.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Description__c
fields.label: Description
fields.desc: May be used to add a description or note for this Order record.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Gateway__c
fields.label: Gateway
fields.desc: The payment gateway to be used for this order.
fields.help: Select the gateway configuration that this order will be processed with.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Invoice_Number__c
fields.label: Invoice Number
fields.desc: Stores a unique invoice ID entered by the user. This field is used by finance departments to reconcile transactions, and is typically used for Level II and III transactions.
fields.help: When processing business or procurement cards, having this field populated can lower you card processing fees.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Manual_Charge__c
fields.label: Manual Charge
fields.desc: Check this box when you want to authorize or charge an amount different than the amount due on the order. This will prevent the "Charge Amount" from being automatically calculated and updated.
fields.help: Check this box when you want to authorize or charge an amount different than the amount due on the order. This will prevent the "Charge Amount" from being automatically calculated and updated.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Next_Transaction_Date__c
fields.label: Next Transaction Date
fields.desc: Use this field to double check and ensure that your recurring payment details are setup correctly. This field DOES NOT control WHEN a charge will be done. Rather Chargent applies the same logic here that our scheduling engine does
fields.help: This field reports to you when Chargent will auto-charge this order.  Changing this date will have no impact on when the order is charged.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__No_Tax__c
fields.label: No Tax
fields.help: This may have been set by the Colgin Administrator on a Manual Order

fields.name: ChargentOrders__OrderNumber__c
fields.label: Order Number
fields.desc: Stores, then sends the Order/Invoice number  to the gateway when the transaction is made. Also used in the TChargentBatchProcessing batch process.
fields.help: This number is passed over to your gateway.  Typically this is a unique ID for this order in your system.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__OrderSource__c
fields.label: Order Source
fields.desc: The Order Source field defines the order entry source for this transaction.
fields.help: Where did this payment data come from?

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Order_Information__c
fields.label: Order Information
fields.desc: Stores user entered data about this record. The contents of this field are sent the gateway when Level III transactions are initiated, and are typically mapped to the "Description" field on the gateway's transaction record
fields.help: Enter order information (sometimes referred to as the "description") into this field for Level III transactions.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Order_Note__c
fields.label: Note
fields.desc: allow users to type a short note

fields.name: ChargentOrders__PO_Number__c
fields.label: PO Number
fields.desc: For Level II transactions, this field records the Purchase Order number for the card being used. This is also known as the "Customer Code."
fields.help: Sometimes referred to as the "Customer Code" for Level II transactions.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_Count__c
fields.label: Payment Count
fields.desc: When the Payment Stop rule of "Count" is selected for recurring orders, this field dictates the number of payments to be collected before the recurring order stops.
fields.help: When the Payment Stop field is set to Count this field tells the system the total number of completed transactions.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_Descriptor__c
fields.label: Payment Descriptor
fields.desc: This field serves as a description of what is being paid for on this record. For example, if this Chargent Order record is being used for a recurring payment for a VIP membership, you might enter the details of that membership here; “24hr gym access + valet service”. Note that this field is often customer-facing as it is used when configuring Chargent Components on pages or Flows.
fields.help: This field serves as a description of what is being paid for on this record. For example, if this Chargent Order record is being used for a recurring payment for a VIP membership, you might enter the details of that membership here; “24hr gym access + valet service”. Note that this field is often customer-facing as it is used when configuring Chargent Components on pages or Flows.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_End_Date__c
fields.label: Payment End Date
fields.desc: When the Payment Stop rule of "Date" is slected, this field determins the date on which this recurring order will stop.
fields.help: When the Payment Stop field is set to Date this field tells the system the total number of completed transactions.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_Frequency__c
fields.label: Payment Frequency
fields.desc:
The frequency on which this recurring order will collect payments. 
E.g., Daily, Weekly, Monthly.
fields.help: How often should Chargent automatically charge this payment source? E.g., Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Annually, Bi-Annually (twice per year).

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_Method__c
fields.label: Payment Method
fields.desc:
The type of payment source used for payment on this order.

E.g., Credit Card, Bank Account, Money Order, Cash
fields.help:
Enter the type of payment.  

E.g., Credit Card, Bank Account

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_Received__c
fields.label: Payment Received
fields.desc: This field displays whether a payment for this order has been received. It will show 'None,' 'Partial,' or 'Full.'
fields.help: This field displays whether a payment for this order has been received. It will show 'None,' 'Partial,' or 'Full.'

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_Start_Date__c
fields.label: Payment Start Date
fields.desc: Chargent will not attempt to charge this record until the Start Date
fields.help: Enter the first date that Chargent should automatically charge this order.  Note that without this date no charge will ever happen!

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_Status__c
fields.label: Payment Status
fields.desc: Reflects the status of this order. For instance, recurring orders will show "Recurring." Orders in collections status will show "Automated Collection." Recurring orders that have failed and AREN'T in collections will show "Error."
fields.help: This field must be set to Recurring to enable the Chargent recurring payment processing functions.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_Template__c
fields.label: Payment Template
fields.desc: Payment Request Configuration Name

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_Title__c
fields.label: Payment Title
fields.desc: This field serves as the title of this record. For example: If this Chargent Order record is used for a recurring payment for a VIP membership, you might enter “VIP Membership” here. Note that this field is often customer-facing as it is used when configuring Chargent Components on pages or Flows.
fields.help: This field serves as the title of this record. For example: If this Chargent Order record is used for a recurring payment for a VIP membership, you might enter “VIP Membership” here. Note that this field is often customer-facing as it is used when configuring Chargent Components on pages or Flows.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Shipping_Address_Line_2__c
fields.label: Shipping Address Line 2
fields.desc: For Level II transactions, this field records the apt, unit, floor, or suite of the shipping address associated with this order.
fields.help: For Level II transactions, this field records the apt, unit, floor, or suite of the shipping address associated with this order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Shipping_Address__c
fields.label: Shipping Address
fields.desc: For Level II transactions, this field records the street name and number of the shipping address associated with this order.
fields.help: For Level II transactions, this field records the street name and number of the shipping address associated with this order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Shipping_City__c
fields.label: Shipping City
fields.desc: For Level II transactions, this field records the city of the shipping address associated with this order.
fields.help: For Level II transactions, this field records the city of the shipping address associated with this order.

Auth.net
Cybersource
FatZebra
Forte
NMI

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Shipping_Country__c
fields.label: Shipping Country
fields.desc: For Level II transactions, this field records the country of the shipping address associated with this order.
fields.help: For Level II transactions, this field records the country of the shipping address associated with this order.
pick: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Shipping_Duty__c
fields.label: Shipping Duty
fields.desc: For Level II & III transactions, this field records the duty for shipping to the shipping address associated with this order.
fields.help: Total charges for any import or export duties included in the order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Shipping_First_Name__c
fields.label: Shipping First Name
fields.desc: For Level II transactions, this field records the first name at the shipping address associated with this order.
fields.help: For Level II transactions, this field records the first name at the shipping address associated with this order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Shipping_Instructions__c
fields.label: Shipping Instructions
fields.desc: For Level II transactions, this field records the shipping instructions associated with this order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Shipping_Name__c
fields.label: Shipping Last Name
fields.desc: For Level II transactions, this field records the last name at the shipping address associated with this order.
fields.help: For Level II transactions, this field records the last name at the shipping address associated with this order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Shipping_Phone__c
fields.label: Shipping Phone
fields.desc: For Level II transactions, this field records the phone number at the shipping address associated with this order.
fields.help: For Level II transactions, this field records the phone number at the shipping address associated with this order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Shipping_State__c
fields.label: Shipping State
fields.desc: For Level II transactions, this field records the state of the shipping address associated with this order.
fields.help: For Level II transactions, this field records the state of the shipping address associated with this order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Shipping_Zip_Postal__c
fields.label: Shipping Zip/Postal
fields.desc: For Level II transactions, this field records the zip / postal code at the shipping address associated with this order.
fields.help: For Level II transactions, this field records the zip / postal code at the shipping address associated with this order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Shipping__c
fields.label: Shipping Amount
fields.desc: For Level III transactions, this field records the shipping cost to ship to the address associated with this order.
fields.help: Sometimes referred to as the "Freight Amount" for Level III transactions.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Subtotal__c
fields.label: Subtotal
fields.desc: The subtotal is the amount due before taxes, shipping, or other fees are added to the order.
fields.help: Subtotal is the field where Chargent gets the Total.  It is the first field in the equation to get to the Total.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Tax_Exempt__c
fields.label: Tax Exempt
fields.desc: Used in Level II data to indicate that this order is Tax Exempt.
fields.help: Check this box to indicate that this payment is tax-exempt. This is often used for Level II transactions.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Tax__c
fields.label: Tax
fields.desc: For Level II transactions, this field reflects the tax charged for this order.
fields.help: For Level II transactions, this field reflects the tax charged for this order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Tokenization__c
fields.label: Token
fields.desc:
This displays the token received from the gateway that replaces the payment source data.

Tokenization must be enabled at both in your gateway's administration portal and in the Chargent gateway record configuration.

This field is typically managed by Chargent.  

During data migrations one will often update this field.
fields.help: The token is the secured payment method from your gateway.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Tracking_Number__c
fields.label: Tracking Number
fields.desc: May be used to document the courier tracking number for an order involving a shipment.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Update_Token__c
fields.label: Update Token
fields.desc: This checkbox is used by the createTransaction method to indicate whether a transaction being created should update the stored token (in cases where a new token is provided by the gateway).
fields.help: This checkbox is used by the createTransaction method to indicate whether a transaction being created should update the stored token (in cases where a new token is provided by the gateway).

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Balance_Due__c
fields.label: Balance Due
fields.desc: This field subtracts the total of all transactions (both manual and recurring) from the Total field. The Payment Stop option of Balance Due uses this field to determine when to stop recurring charges.
fields.help: Show the total remaining amount to be paid by the customer.  Formula is: Total - Transaction Total

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Bank_Account_Type__c
fields.label: Bank Account Type
fields.desc:
The descriptor given by the financial institution that holds the account.
This is important, as certain systems may not allow payment to be taken from certain types of accounts.
e.g., Checking, Business Checking, Savings, Money Market.
fields.help: Is this a checking, savings or other type of bank account?

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Card_Type__c
fields.label: Card Type
fields.desc: E.g., Visa, MasterCard, American Express.
fields.help: E.g., Visa, MasterCard, American Express.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Credit_Card_Name__c
fields.label: Card Name
fields.desc: Name on the card to be charged - will default to Billing First and Billing Last
fields.help: This is the name of the card holder, as it appears on the card.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Next_Scheduled_Payment__c
fields.label: Next Scheduled Payment
fields.help: This field reports to you when Chargent will auto-charge this order.  Changing this date will have no impact on when the order is charged.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Order_Link__c
fields.label: Order Link
fields.desc: This field is used to provide a hyperlink pointing to the Chargent Order record that can be used in reporting and list views.
fields.help: This field is used to provide a hyperlink pointing to the Chargent Order record that can be used in reporting and list views.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_Stop__c
fields.label: Payment Stop
fields.desc:
This field determins the stop-rule for a recurring order.
DATE = Recurring schedule stops on a specific date
COUNT = Recurring schedule stops after a specific number of charges completes
BALANCE DUE = Recurring schedule stops after a specific amount has been reached
UNENDING = Recurring schedule doesn't stop unless manually stopped
fields.help: Set this value to tell Chargent when to end the automatic recurring payments.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Total__c
fields.label: Total
fields.desc:
This field is calculated by adding subtotal, tax and shipping together.

The total field populates the Charge Amount field, when Manual Charge is set to FALSE.

ChargentOrders__Subtotal__c + ChargentOrders__Tax__c + ChargentOrders__Shipping__c
fields.help: Chargent adds the Subtotal, Tax and Shipping together to get this number.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__UseTokenization__c
fields.label: Use Tokenization
fields.desc: If TRUE then the associated Gateway record has Tokenization enabled, if FALSE the associated Gateway record does not have tokenization enabled.
fields.help: This field indicates whether or not tokenization is enabled on the related gateway record. Chargent also uses this field to determine when to erase card data.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Last_Recurring_Transaction__c
fields.label: Last Recurring Transaction
fields.desc: Displays the most recent date on which a trasnaction was made on this recurring order.
fields.help: This formula tells you when the last recurring transaction was completed.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Last_Transaction__c
fields.label: Last Transaction
fields.desc: Displays the most recent date on which a transaction was made on this order.
fields.help: Displays the most recent date on which a transaction was made on this order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Transaction_Count_Recurring__c
fields.label: Transaction Count Recurring
fields.desc:
Total number of "Approved" transactions created by a recurring payment schedule. The formula used:

(Response StatusEQUALSApproved, Pre-settlement) AND (RecurringEQUALSTrue) AND (TypeEQUALSCharge, Batch Processing)
fields.help: This field shows the total number of transactions with an "Approved" or "Pre-settlement" status on Chargent Order records with arecurring payment schedule.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Transaction_Count__c
fields.label: Transaction Count
fields.desc: This field provides a total of all transactions created for this Order record.
fields.help: Total count of all transactions associated to this payment.  Counts declines, errors and successful transactions.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Transaction_Total__c
fields.label: Transaction Total
fields.desc: Total of all Charges and Refunds (expressed in negative) with a Response of "Approved"
fields.help: This is the total of all successful transactions. Refund transactions are also factored into this field and are subtracted from the total.

fields.name: Opportunity__c
fields.label: Opportunity
fields.desc: This field will relate a chargent order to an opportunity.

fields.name: Automation_Log__c
fields.label: Automation Log
fields.desc: This field will host automation log data from automated process that effect this record.

fields.name: Payment_Link__c
fields.label: Payment Link
fields.desc: This field will hold the most recent payment link for a Chargent Order.
fields.help: This field will hold the most recent payment link for a Chargent Order.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_Method_Default__c
fields.label: Payment Method Default
fields.desc: This is the currently active payment method for this Chargent Order. This payment method will be used for recurring and one-time payment transactions.

fields.name: Bypass_Chargent_Order__c
fields.label: Bypass Chargent Order
fields.desc: This field will allow administration to bypass the need of "Balance Due = 0.00" for the flow to continue.

fields.name: ChargentOrders__UUID__c
fields.label: Chargent UUID
fields.desc: This universally unique identifier is used by the Chargent system to ensure data integrity

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Payment_Method_UUID__c
fields.label: Payment Method UUID
fields.desc: The Default Payment Method UUID
fields.help: The Default Payment Method UUID

fields.name: ChargentOrders__Contact__c
fields.label: Billing Contact
fields.desc: Lookup field to the Contact to which this Order is related.This shows the Contact record this order was created for or used by. fields.formula:
IF(CASE( Account.ShippingState , 'CA', 1, 'NV', 1,'OR', 1, 'WA', 1, 0) >=1, "PT", null)+
IF(CASE(Account.ShippingState , 'AZ', 1, 'CO', 1,'ID', 1, 'MT', 1, 'NM', 1, 'UT', 1, 'WY', 1, 0) >= 1, "MT", null)+
IF(CASE(Account.ShippingState , 'AL', 1, 'AR', 1, 'IL', 1, 'IA', 1,'KS', 1, 'LA', 1,'MN', 1,'MS', 1,'MO', 1,'NE', 1,'ND', 1, 'OK', 1,'SD', 1,'WI', 1, 'TX',1,0) >= 1, "CT", null)+
IF(CASE(Account.ShippingState , 'CT', 1, 'DE', 1, 'GA', 1, 'ME', 1, 'MD', 1, 'MA', 1,'MI', 1, 'NH', 1, 'NJ', 1, 'NY', 1, 'NC', 1, 'OH', 1, 'PA', 1, 'RI', 1, 'SC', 1, 'VT', 1, 'VA', 1, 'WV', 1, 'FL', 1, 'IN',1,'KY',1,'TN',1,0) >= 1,"ET", null)+
IF(CASE(Account.ShippingState , 'AK', 1, 0) >=1, "AK", null)+
IF(CASE(Account.ShippingState , 'HI', 1, 0) >=1, "HI", null)

fields.label: Field Score
fields.formula:
IF(ISNULL(fpro__Last_Refresh_Date_MCD__c), -1, 
(
IF(fpro__Populate_Percentage__c < (10/100), 0, 30)
+
IF(fpro__References_Apex_Class_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Apex_Trigger_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Visualforce_Page_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Visualforce_Components_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Formula_Fields_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Page_Layouts_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Profile_Visibility_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Permission_Sets_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Validation_Rules_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Workflow_Field_Updates_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Workflow_Rules_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Flow_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Reports_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_ReportType_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
+
IF(fpro__References_Others_Count__c = 0, 0, 5)
))
fields.desc: Roughly calculated score for this salesforce field using other parameters like field usage, apex/metadata references etc. Score 0 means the field is a potential candidate for deletion, as probably not being used anywhere.

If (WEEKDAY( DateValue(CreatedDate) )=5,"5-THURSDAY",
If (WEEKDAY( DateValue(CreatedDate) )=6,"6-FRIDAY",

"OTHER")))))))

fields.name: Day_Created__c
fields.label: Day Created
fields.formula:
"UTC: " &
CASE(
MOD(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) - DATE(1985, 6, 24), 7),
0, "Monday",
1, "Tuesday",
2, "Wednesday",
3, "Thursday",
4, "Friday",
5, "Saturday",
6, "Sunday",
"Unknown"
)
& " | EDT: " &
CASE(
MOD(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate - (7.0/24)) - DATE(1985, 6, 24), 7),
0, "Monday",
1, "Tuesday",
2, "Wednesday",
3, "Thursday",
4, "Friday",
5, "Saturday",
6, "Sunday",
"Unknown"
)

fields.name: First_Available_Call_Time__c
fields.label: First Available Call Time (EST)
fields.formula:
IF(OR(
ISPICKVAL(Owner:User.TimeZoneSidKey,"(GMT-08:00) Pacific Standard Time (America/Vancouver)"),
ISPICKVAL(Owner:User.TimeZoneSidKey ,"(GMT-07:00) Pacific Daylight Time (America/Vancouver)")
),
IF(AND(
OR(
Day_of_Week_Created__c = 2,
Day_of_Week_Created__c = 3,
Day_of_Week_Created__c = 4,
Day_of_Week_Created__c = 5,
Day_of_Week_Created__c = 6
),
AND(
Created_Time_Less_4_24__c >= TIMEVALUE("00:00:00.000"),
Created_Time_Less_4_24__c < TIMEVALUE("08:00:00.000")
)
),
DATETIMEVALUE(CreatedDate),
DATETIMEVALUE(
DATE(
YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)),
MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)),
DAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate + IF(Created_Time_Less_4_24__c < TIMEVALUE("08:00:00.000"), (Day_Light_Savings__c), 0)))
)
) + (12.5/24) + (Day_Light_Savings__c-(1/24)) +
IF(
OR(
Day_of_Week_Created__c = 1,
AND(
Day_of_Week_Created__c <> 7,
Day_of_Week_Created__c <> 6,
Created_Time_Less_4_24__c >= TIMEVALUE("08:00:00.000")
)
),
1,
IF(Day_of_Week_Created__c = 7, 2,
IF(Day_of_Week_Created__c = 6, 3, 0)
)
)
),
IF(AND(
OR(
Day_of_Week_Created__c = 2,
Day_of_Week_Created__c = 3,
Day_of_Week_Created__c = 4,
Day_of_Week_Created__c = 5,
Day_of_Week_Created__c = 6
),
Created_Time_Less_4_24__c > TIMEVALUE("08:00:00.000"),
Created_Time_Less_4_24__c < TIMEVALUE("18:00:00.000")
),
DATETIMEVALUE(CreatedDate),
DATETIMEVALUE(
DATE(
YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)),
MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)),
DAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate + IF(Created_Time_Less_4_24__c < TIMEVALUE("18:00:00.000"), (Day_Light_Savings__c), 0)))
)
) + (12.5/24) + Time_Zone_Adjustment_2__c +
IF(
OR(
Day_of_Week_Created__c = 1,
AND(
Day_of_Week_Created__c <> 7,
Day_of_Week_Created__c <> 6,
Created_Time_Less_4_24__c > TIMEVALUE("18:00:00.000")
)
),
1,
IF(Day_of_Week_Created__c = 7, 2,
IF(Day_of_Week_Created__c = 6, 3, 0)
)
)
)
)

))))

fields.label: South Asian Last Name
fields.desc: TRUE when the Lead LastName matcheAs a known South Asian surname. The list is held as a semicolon-delimited blob and matched with CONTAINS, because one OR/CASE clause per name hits the 3,900-character formula limit at about 140 names. This encoding costs ~7 characters per name instead of ~15-27, so all 357 names fit in one field with room for roughly 160 more. To add a name: insert it lowercase between two semicolons. Do not create a second formula field and OR them together - Salesforce inlines referenced formulas, so the combined compiled size exceeds the 5,000-byte limit.

fields.name: UTC_Date__c
fields.label: UTC Date
fields.formula:
IF(
  AND(
    CreatedDate >= DATETIMEVALUE(
      TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & "-03-" &
      TEXT(15 - MOD(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 3, 1) - DATE(1985, 6, 24), 7)) &
      " 02:00:00"
    ),
    CreatedDate < DATETIMEVALUE(
      TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & "-11-" &
      TEXT(8 - MOD(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 11, 1) - DATE(1985, 6, 24), 7)) &
      " 02:00:00"
    )
  ),
  /* DST: EDT = UTC - 4 */
  CASE(
    MOD(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate - (4.0/24)) - DATE(1985,6,24), 7),
    0, "Monday", 1, "Tuesday", 2, "Wednesday",
    3, "Thursday", 4, "Friday", 5, "Saturday",
    6, "Sunday", "Unknown"
  ) & " " &
  TEXT(MOD(FLOOR((CreatedDate - (4.0/24) - DATETIMEVALUE("1900-01-01 00:00:00")) * 24), 24)),

  /* Standard: EST = UTC - 5 */
  CASE(
    MOD(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate - (5.0/24)) - DATE(1985,6,24), 7),
    0, "Monday", 1, "Tuesday", 2, "Wednesday",
    3, "Thursday", 4, "Friday", 5, "Saturday",
    6, "Sunday", "Unknown"
  ) & " " &
  TEXT(MOD(FLOOR((CreatedDate - (5.0/24) - DATETIMEVALUE("1900-01-01 00:00:00")) * 24), 24))
)

fields.name: UTC_EST_Time_Only__c
fields.label: UTC/EST Time Only
fields.formula:
"UTC Hour: " & 
TEXT(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & 
" | EDT Hour: " & 
TEXT(
  HOUR(
    TIMEVALUE(
      CreatedDate - (
        IF(
          AND(
            CreatedDate >= DATETIMEVALUE(
              TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & "-03-" &
              TEXT(15 - MOD(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 3, 1) - DATE(1985, 6, 24), 7)) &
              " 02:00:00"
            ),
            CreatedDate < DATETIMEVALUE(
              TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))) & "-11-" &
              TEXT(8 - MOD(DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 11, 1) - DATE(1985, 6, 24), 7)) &
              " 02:00:00"
            )
          ),
          4.0/24,  /* EDT */
          5.0/24   /* EST */
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

fields.name: Workload_Score__c
fields.label: Workload Score
fields.formula:
IF(
  OR(
    TEXT(LeadSource) = "Marketing - Customer Referral",
    TEXT(Sub_Type__c) = "Additional Location",
    TEXT(StageName) = "Closed Won",
    TEXT(StageName) = "Closed Lost"
  ),
  0,

  /* SQL verified in last 14 days */
  IF(
    AND(
      SQL_Verification_Date__c >= TODAY() - 14,
      SQL_Verification_Date__c <= TODAY()
    ),
    20,
    0
  )
  +
  /* SQL verified in last 60 days */
  IF(
    AND(
      SQL_Verification_Date__c >= TODAY() - 60,
      SQL_Verification_Date__c <= TODAY()
    ),
    50,
    0
  )
  +
  /* Stage points: 20 for BDR Qualified, otherwise 10 */
  IF(
    TEXT(StageName) = "BDR Qualified",
    20,
    10
  )
)
fields.desc: Calculates workload score for Kubaru

fields.label: Update Expected Execution Date
fields.formula:
IF( AND( RDNACadence__Participant_Type__c = "Contact", ISBLANK(RDNACadence__Contact_Id__r.RDNACadence__EntranceCriteria_Matched_Date__c) = TRUE),
			RDNACadence__Contact_Id__r.RDNACadence__EntranceCriteria_Matched_Date__c + 
		(	RDNACadence__CadenceAction_ID__r.RDNACadence__Day__c +
 (RDNACadence__CadenceAction_ID__r.RDNACadence__Hour__c /24)) 			 
			,  
			
			IF(AND(RDNACadence__Participant_Type__c = "Lead",ISBLANK(RDNACadence__Lead_Id__r.RDNACadence__EntranceCriteria_Matched_Date__c)=TRUE),
						RDNACadence__Lead_Id__r.RDNACadence__EntranceCriteria_Matched_Date__c+
					(	RDNACadence__CadenceAction_ID__r.RDNACadence__Day__c + 
			   (RDNACadence__CadenceAction_ID__r.RDNACadence__Hour__c /24))
						,
			
			NOW()
		
		))

fields.name: New_Owner_Display__c
fields.label: New Owner Display
fields.formula:
IF(
  NOT(ISBLANK(NewOwner_User__c)),
   NewOwner_User__r.Full_Name__c,
  IF(
    NOT(ISBLANK(New_Owner_Queue_Name__c)),
    New_Owner_Queue_Name__c,
    ""
  )
)

fields.name: Summary__c
fields.label: Summary
fields.formula:
IF(
  ISPICKVAL(Log_Type__c, "Tier Change"),
  "Tier changed from " & BLANKVALUE(Previous_Tier__c, "(none)") & " to " & BLANKVALUE(New_Tier__c, "(none)")
    & IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Duration_in_Previous_Tier_Min__c)), Duration_in_Previous_Tier_Min__c > 0),
        " (" & TEXT(Duration_in_Previous_Tier_Min__c) & " min in previous tier)", ""),
  IF(
    Queue_to_User_Transfer__c,
    "Assigned from " & BLANKVALUE(Previous_Owner_Display__c, "queue") & " to " & BLANKVALUE(New_Owner_Display__c, "(unassigned)")
      & IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Duration_with_Previous_Owner__c)), Duration_with_Previous_Owner__c > 0),
          " (" & TEXT(Duration_with_Previous_Owner__c) & " min in queue)", ""),
    "Reassigned from " & BLANKVALUE(Previous_Owner_Display__c, "(unassigned)") & " to " & BLANKVALUE(New_Owner_Display__c, "(unassigned)")
      & IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Duration_with_Previous_Owner__c)), Duration_with_Previous_Owner__c > 0),
          " (" & TEXT(Duration_with_Previous_Owner__c) & " min with previous owner)", "")
  )
)
fields.desc: Plain-language one-line summary of the history entry so users can read what happened at a glance. Distinguishes a queue-to-agent assignment (with time waited in queue) from a reassignment between owners (with time the previous owner held it), and tier changes. Works for legacy rows with no Log Type by defaulting to the owner format.

fields.name: Average_Score__c
fields.label: Average Score
fields.formula:
IF(
  (IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_1__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_1__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_2__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_2__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_3__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_3__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_4__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_4__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_5__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_5__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_6__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_6__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_7__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_7__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_8__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_8__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_9__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_9__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
   IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_10__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_10__c)) = 0), 0, 1)) = 0,
  0,
  (
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_1__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_1__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_1__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_2__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_2__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_2__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_3__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_3__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_3__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_4__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_4__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_4__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_5__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_5__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_5__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_6__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_6__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_6__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_7__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_7__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_7__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_8__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_8__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_8__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_9__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_9__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_9__c))) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_10__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_10__c)) = 0), 0, VALUE(TEXT(Response_10__c)))
  ) /
  (
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_1__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_1__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_2__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_2__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_3__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_3__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_4__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_4__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_5__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_5__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_6__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_6__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_7__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_7__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_8__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_8__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_9__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_9__c)) = 0), 0, 1) +
    IF(OR(ISBLANK(Response_10__c), VALUE(TEXT(Response_10__c)) = 0), 0, 1)
  )
)
